template_selection.summary: Plan 1 VLM bbox JSON provides layout roles only. Garment class, sleeve length, and skirt style come from bench/plan1_localization/garment_attributes.json (reviewed evidence). catalog_template_selector_v1 maps normalized attributes to template_id with confidence; template_override in a manifest case forces an explicit reviewed override.
mapping_rules: skirt + a_line/flared or missing subtype -> skirt (low confidence without subtype)
dress + half sleeve + knee_length -> dress_knee_length_half_sleeve (catalog role=dress)
dress + full sleeve + knee_length -> dress_knee_length_full_sleeve (catalog role=dress)

prompt_policy.summary: Role/template-specific generation policy with texture integrity. Image 1 (segmented cutout) is authoritative for exact color, material, weave, pattern, embroidery, trim, buttons, seams, and lapels/pockets where visible. Optional Image 3 detail crop reinforces source texture for tops. Template controls outer geometry/sleeve style only; never transfer template gray or simplify texture. All tops (including blazers) render closed/front-facing while preserving source-visible details. Bottoms avoid descriptor leakage and do not invent hardware unless clearly visible in the segmented source.

production.policy: one 1K API call plus deterministic local 512 LANCZOS derivative ({role}.png); idempotent/resumable with hash-based reuse
